nodes.label: PR Template Validation Workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs on pull_request_target so it can comment and close on forks. Maintainers and bots (blakeblackshear, NickM-27, hawkeye217, dependabot, weblate) are allowlisted and skipped. Missing sections, an empty Proposed change, or unchecked Type of change / AI disclosure / Checklist boxes cause an explanatory comment plus an automatic close, pushing the compliance cost onto the author rather than the reviewer.

edges.source_location: both are automated maintainer-load reducers that close contributions without human review, one on format compliance and one on inactivity
